Synopsis:
A trader from the Zhentarim (z-HENT-ah-rim) , a shady organisation of spies, assassins and dealers in illicit goods. The player may or may not recognise her as such, but either way her attitude is blunt, breezy and unscrupulous. She's there to make money, and you're either there to make a deal or wasting her time - she has absolutely no interest in indecision or moralizing.

Cluster Contexts:
- GOB_QuartermasterFlimsy.json: Roah Moonglow is a Zhentarim trader — you can spot the winged‑serpent crest — though the player might or might not have recognised the sigil before. She deals in illicit goods (weapons, “exotic” items, smokepowder and the like) and buys prisoners from goblin bands; above all she sells discretion and profit. She’s been doing business in or near a goblin camp, but some of her usual sources have started sending captives to Moonrise Towers, so she’s been adapting (and still made a tidy sum selling smokepowder). Her manner is blunt, breezy and impatient: everything’s business, she has no patience for moralising, and she expects you to either trade or be on your way.
- MOO_Bazaar_Zhent00.json: A Zhentarim trader from the goblin camp. Roah will react based on your actions if you've met her, or give a brief summary of the Zhentarim's connection to the Absolute if not.
- PLA_ZhentDungeon_Zhent03.json: Brem is a trader for the Zhentarim. When we meet him, he's holding an artist prisoner and offering us a portrait. We can persuade him to release the prisoner or just buy him outright - or just trade normally. He'll indicate that there are more illicit items he can show us - once we prove ourselves to his leader.
- NGB_FOR_Village_Trespassing.json: This guard has come upon you sneaking through a village her force is occupying. She was bored and sees you as a potential source of fun (ie, someone to murder/bully).  Defaulting to she, but numerous goblins could deliver this dialogue as it's a dynamic crime one.
- LOW_Guildhall_Zhent_Mercenary_001.json: Zhent Mercenary informs player they are at the guild to help Nine-fingers beat the Stone Lord
